008package paint.viewer.ui.panels;
009
010import paint.viewer.model.RecordingEntry;
011
012import javax.swing.*;
013import javax.swing.table.DefaultTableModel;
014import java.awt.*;
015
016/**
017 * A Swing panel that presents attributes of a {@link RecordingEntry} in tabular form.
018 * <p>
019 * The panel includes a scrollable, non-editable table showing probe, experiment,
020 * and computed parameters for the active recording.
021 */
022public class RecordingAttributesPanel {
023
024    private final JPanel            root;
025    private final DefaultTableModel model;
026
027    /**
028     * Constructs a new {@code RecordingAttributesPanel}.
029     * <p>
030     * Initializes a styled, non-editable table for displaying recording attributes.
031     * The layout uses a {@link BorderLayout} with compound borders and a scroll pane
032     * for readability and integration within parent components.
033     */
034    public RecordingAttributesPanel() {
035        root = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
036        root.setBorder(BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(
037                BorderFactory.createLineBorder(Color.DARK_GRAY, 2),
038                BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(10, 10, 10, 10)
039        ));
040        root.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(240, 0));
041
042        model = new DefaultTableModel(new Object[]{"Attr", "Val"}, 0) {
043            public boolean isCellEditable(int r, int c) {
044                return false;
045            }
046        };
047        JTable table = new JTable(model);
048        table.setRowHeight(22);
049        table.setFocusable(false);
050        table.setRowSelectionAllowed(false);
051        table.getTableHeader().setFont(new Font("SansSerif", Font.BOLD, 12));
052        table.getColumnModel().getColumn(0).setPreferredWidth(100); // "Attr"
053        table.getColumnModel().getColumn(1).setPreferredWidth(50);  // "Val"
054
055        JScrollPane scroll = new JScrollPane(table);
056        root.add(scroll, BorderLayout.CENTER);
057    }
058
059    /**
060     * Returns the root Swing component representing this panel.
061     *
062     * @return the root {@link JComponent}
063     */
064    public JComponent getComponent() {
065        return root;
066    }
067
068    /**
069     * Updates the displayed attributes using data from the specified recording entry.
070     *
071     * @param recordingEntry the {@link RecordingEntry} containing the data
072     * @param numSquares     the number of squares associated with this recording
073     */
074    public void updateFromEntry(RecordingEntry recordingEntry, int numSquares) {
075        model.setRowCount(0);
076        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Probe",             recordingEntry.getProbeName()});
077        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Probe Type",        recordingEntry.getProbeType()});
078        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Adjuvant",          recordingEntry.getAdjuvant()});
079        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Cell Type",         recordingEntry.getCellType()});
080        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Concentration",     recordingEntry.getConcentration()});
081        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Number of Spots",   recordingEntry.getNumberOfSpots()});
082        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Number of Tracks",  recordingEntry.getNumberOfTracks()});
083        addWholeScreenTauRows(recordingEntry, numSquares);
084        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Number of Squares", numSquares});
085        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Threshold",         recordingEntry.getThreshold()});
086        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Min Density Ratio", recordingEntry.getRecording().getMinRequiredDensityRatio()});
087        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Max Variability",   recordingEntry.getRecording().getMaxAllowableVariability()});
088        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Min Required R²",   format(recordingEntry.getRecording().getMinRequiredRSquared(), 2)});
089        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Neighbour Mode",    recordingEntry.getRecording().getNeighbourMode()});
090    }
091
092    /**
093     * Temporarily updates the displayed attributes to preview parameter changes.
094     * <p>
095     * This does not modify the underlying {@link RecordingEntry}.
096     *
097     * @param recordingEntry  the current recording entry (for static attributes)
098     * @param numSquares      number of squares for the recording
099     * @param minDensityRatio minimum density ratio threshold
100     * @param maxVariability  maximum variability threshold
101     * @param minRSquared     minimum R² threshold
102     * @param neighbourMode   neighbour mode label (“Free”, “Relaxed”, “Strict”)
103     */
104    public void updatePreview(
105            RecordingEntry recordingEntry,
106            int            numSquares,
107            double         minDensityRatio,
108            double         maxVariability,
109            double         minRSquared,
110            String         neighbourMode) {
111
112        model.setRowCount(0);
113        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Probe",               recordingEntry.getProbeName()});
114        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Probe Type",          recordingEntry.getProbeType()});
115        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Adjuvant",            recordingEntry.getAdjuvant()});
116        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Cell Type",           recordingEntry.getCellType()});
117        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Concentration",       recordingEntry.getConcentration()});
118        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Number of Spots",     recordingEntry.getNumberOfSpots()});
119        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Number of Tracks",    recordingEntry.getNumberOfTracks()});
120        addWholeScreenTauRows(recordingEntry, numSquares);
121        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Number of Squares",   numSquares});
122        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Threshold",           recordingEntry.getThreshold()});
123        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Min Density Ratio",   format(minDensityRatio, 1)});
124        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Max Variability",     format(maxVariability,  1)});
125        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Min Required R²",     format(minRSquared,     2)});
126        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Neighbour Mode",      neighbourMode});
127    }
128
129    /**
130     * With a 1x1 grid, adds the recording's Tau and R² as rows. The single square is then the
131     * whole recording, so this is the whole-screen Tau. The values are those stored in
132     * Recordings.csv by Generate Squares; nothing is recalculated and no tracks are needed.
133     *
134     * @param recordingEntry the current recording entry
135     * @param numSquares     number of squares per recording
136     */
137    private void addWholeScreenTauRows(RecordingEntry recordingEntry, int numSquares) {
138        if (numSquares != 1) {
139            return;
140        }
141        double tau = recordingEntry.getRecording().getTau();
142        model.addRow(new Object[]{"Tau",  Double.isNaN(tau) ? "NaN" : format(tau, 0) + " ms"});
143        model.addRow(new Object[]{"R²",   format(recordingEntry.getRecording().getRSquared(), 2)});
144    }
145
146    /**
147     * Formats a numeric value to the specified precision, handling NaN and infinity cases.
148     *
149     * @param value the value to format
150     * @param precision number of decimal places
151     * @return formatted string representation of the value
152     */
153    private static String format(double value, int precision) {
154        if (Double.isNaN(value)) {
155            return "NaN";
156        }
157        if (Double.isInfinite(value)) {
158            return value > 0 ? "∞" : "-∞";
159        }
160        return String.format("%." + precision + "f", value);
161    }
162}
